items.title: TIL: How to Not Let Coding Agents Commit Code Automatically
items.content_html: TL;DR Coding agents shouldn't auto-commit. There are four ways to enforce that, from a static permission deny to a dynamic per-session authorization flag. The last one also needs a second, independent rule or the agent can create its own authorization.
